steps.content: The bedroom is quite cluttered. Though spacious and lightly furnished, it's filled with flowers. Rahu has a keen sense of smell. The scent of the flowers had already made her frown outside, and is now utterly suffocating.
Surrounded by flowers, the wounded woman on the bed looks even softer and frailer. Compared to the blood-soaked chaos around her, she is pitifully fragile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've been in a coma since yesterday's incident until now. A lot of things have been delayed. To be honest, I didn't expect your arrival.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: A special Sinner of the FAC...
She studies Rahu politely.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're more dashing than I thought. Like a knight.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: How generous of you to let a Sinner come in and talk to you. Aren't you afraid that I'll sully you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I think you're very strong, and that makes me feel at ease.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Plus, you've carried out your duties impeccably and saved me so many times. You deserve my respect and gratitude.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I hope I didn't bring you any unpleasant experiences during my coma. I will explain the situation to the Security Chief.
Rahu remains expressionless.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No need to worry about that. Don't you want to leave this place?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There are Sinners and monsters among the assassins. It's too dangerous for you to be here. You should go back to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I will consider your advice. But before I make a decision, I believe that you guys are able to protect me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You're gonna depend on those worthless sheriffs?
Shalom shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They are shouldering undue pressure and trying their best. Just look at all these flowers.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: After simply hearing that I like flowers, they sent me so many every day. They just want me to have some comfort.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It's because you're from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'm from Paradeisos, but that doesn't mean I am Paradeisos. If it weren't for the attack, I'd be your average Eastside neighbor.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos is very different from what the outside world imagines. It's so far removed from this world... In fact, you can pretend that it does not exist.
Rahu almost lets out a cold snort, but she restrains herself.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: My apologies. What I mean is, now that the enemy is at our doorstep, you need more protection.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Please permit me to enter the villa so I can conduct a thorough check-up for safety hazards. The others aren't capable enough. I'll protect you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Will entering the villa be more convenient for your work?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Of course.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I see. I will file an application with the Paradeisos liaison. The Blue Rain will arrive in less than two days. I will try to get permission for you before then.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But this way, you will also face more danger. The attacker was strong. She was determined to kill me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You really want to protect me?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I swear in the name of the FAC.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Really? Thank you, then. I will try my best, too.
She flashes a kind smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Times are changing. I lack the ability to protect myself, so I am very glad that you're here.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't mention it.
Rahu bows, then turns to leave. When she reaches the door, she turns back again.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: One more thing...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Do you know what... 05257885 is?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is that a code? If needed, I can ask the liaison about it.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No need, forget it. I will protect you well. It's my duty.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Since you're a distinguished guest from <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>, I will definitely give it my all.
With that, she shuts the door and walks into the shadows, leaving this flower-filled villa.
